english.value: English proficiency is required: IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 80 (4.5 for tests after January 2026), or DET 115. Scores must remain valid within two years. Exemptions may cover two consecutive full-time study years in the US/an English-only official-language country, four secondary years at an American-accredited English-medium school abroad, or official AP English Language 4+, IB English Language and Literature 5+, or A/AS English C+. Predicted scores and English-medium instruction alone do not qualify.
